lists.content:
• Own and oversee global accounting operations across Cloudinary’s group entities, ensuring compliance with US GAAP and applicable local accounting requirements.

  • Lead the monthly financial close process across all group entities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

  • Lead the preparation of annual consolidated financial statements in accordance with US GAAP.

  • Own and coordinate the annual external audit processes, working closely with our external auditors and internal stakeholders.

  • Own and coordinate annual tax filings for domestic entities and work with local accounting and tax firms supporting our international subsidiaries.

  • Partner with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve accounting processes, controls, and operational efficiency.

  • Leverage AI and automation tools to streamline accounting, analysis, reporting, and day-to-day financial workflows.

  • Work hands-on with our ERP and financial systems, including NetSuite, to support accurate and scalable accounting operations.

• CPA with a Big 4 background and experience working with technology/high-tech companies.

  • Proven experience as a Controller or in a similar senior accounting role within a global organization.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing accounting operations across multiple entities and jurisdictions.

  • Experience leading consolidation and financial statement preparation in a global environment.

  • Strong technical accounting expertise and in-depth knowledge of US GAAP.

  • A technology-oriented mindset, with experience using AI tools to improve accounting, analysis, reporting, or other financial workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP - a strong advantage.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative and team-oriented approach.

  • Strong ownership mentality, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Cloudinary is looking for a Director of Digital Marketing, a commercially rigorous, technically fluent growth leader to run our integrated Digital Marketing engine across self-service motions.

As the business owner of growth, you will create demand, improve conversion, build owned acquisition surfaces, and translate growth investment into revenue and pipeline outcomes. Working closely with Product, Data, RevOps, Sales, Web, Content, Design and Finance, you will set the growth system, make trade-offs, and create the operating cadence that lets a lean team ship quickly and compound what works.

This is a builder-leader role, not a channel-management role, suited to someone who combines strategic range with personal fluency in performance marketing, SEO, AI discovery, content-led acquisition, conversion optimization, lifecycle and analytics.

lists.content:
• Own Growth Marketing strategy and execution across the self-service PLG funnel, from acquisition through qualified pipeline and new paying accounts.

  • Set the growth portfolio: allocate budget, talent and experimentation capacity across paid acquisition, SEO, GEO/AEO/AI discovery, tools and content, CRO, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Build and scale owned acquisition assets, including programmatic and product-led content, free tools, guides, glossaries, landing pages and emerging agent-friendly discovery surfaces.

  • Lead an evidence-led experimentation program: frame hypotheses, establish success criteria, prioritize tests, make rapid stop/scale decisions, and convert learnings into repeatable playbooks.

  • Own performance visibility and measurement. Partner with Data, RevOps, Product and Sales to maintain trusted funnel definitions, diagnose data discrepancies, establish attribution guardrails, and model maturity from lead to pipeline and revenue.

  • Be the business owner for Growth Marketing ROI: create CFO-ready investment cases, distinguish attributed revenue from influenced value and leading indicators, and make capital-allocation recommendations.

  • Manage and develop a lean, high-output team of employees and specialist contractors; design pod structure, hiring plans, operating processes, quality controls and AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Align senior stakeholders across Product, Web, Content, Design, Sales, RevOps, Finance and leadership, translating growth insights into clear asks, durable ownership and shipped work.

  • Represent Growth Marketing in weekly leadership reviews and executive forums, communicating results, risks, decisions required and next-week priorities with clarity.

• MUST BE EAST COAST

  • 10+ years in B2B SaaS growth, demand generation, PLG or performance marketing, combining strategic leadership with a hands-on approach to driving growth specifically among developer audiences.

  • A target-driven persona with a deep technical understanding of developers, combined with a rigorous grasp of both human developer and AI agent audiences.

  • A track record of owning integrated growth across paid, organic, lifecycle, CRO and content/product-led acquisition, with the judgement to decide where each lever belongs.

  • Strong command of SaaS funnel analytics, attribution, cohort analysis, conversion metrics, budget modelling and executive-level ROI storytelling.

  • Hands-on expertise in performance marketing and organic acquisition, plus working fluency in technical SEO, AI search/discovery, web experimentation and marketing automation.

  • Experience building high-velocity experimentation systems and operating with ambiguity, imperfect data and fast-changing product or market conditions.

  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership: able to align senior stakeholders and work credibly with Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, Sales and creative partners.

  • A practical AI-first operating mindset: uses automation and agents to accelerate research, content, analysis and operational throughput while retaining quality and commercial judgement.

• Experience in developer-facing, API, media technology, infrastructure or technically complex SaaS products.

  • Experience scaling free tools, programmatic content, marketplaces or other owned acquisition products into measurable commercial value.

  • Experience leading distributed employees, agencies and contractor teams across multiple specialist disciplines.

  • Experience in online marketing driving registration.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Head of MIS to lead and scale the systems backbone of our SaaS business. You will own the strategy, delivery, and operations across three functions: IT, Information Systems engineering, and AI Enablement. You will lead managers and specialists, set the technology roadmap for our internal systems and business applications, and drive automation and AI adoption across the company. This is a senior, high-ownership leadership role for someone who can operate at both the strategic and hands-on level - balancing reliability and security with the speed and experimentation a growing SaaS company needs.

TEAMS YOU'LL LEAD

  • IT - led by an IT Manager, responsible for global IT operations, endpoint and device management, onboarding/offboarding, core SaaS platforms, and vendor management.

  • Information Systems Engineering - a team of systems engineers owning business applications, integrations, data flows, and the internal systems that run Sales, Finance, HR, and other functions.

  • AI Enablement - a team driving adoption of AI tools and building internal automations and copilots that make every department more productive.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the MIS strategy & roadmap - define and execute the vision for IT, information systems, and AI enablement, aligned to company growth and business priorities.

  • Lead and grow the organization - manage the IT Manager, Information Systems engineers, and the AI Enablement team; hire, mentor, set goals, and build a high-performing, service-oriented culture.

  • Own business systems & applications - govern the architecture, integration, and lifecycle of core business systems (e.g., CRM, ERP, HRIS, Finance) and the data flows between them.

  • Drive AI & automation adoption - identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across the company, and lead the AI Enablement team in delivering tools, copilots, and workflows that raise productivity.

  • Ensure reliable, secure IT operations - oversee global IT delivery, endpoint and identity management, and employee support through the IT function, partnering closely with Security.

  • Governance, security & compliance - establish policies, access controls, and controls for systems and data; support audit and compliance requirements (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR).

  • Budget & vendor management - own the MIS budget, technology spend, and strategic vendor, consultant, and outsourcing relationships across all three functions.

  • Data & reporting - ensure the business has trustworthy systems data and reporting to support decision-making across departments.

  • Cross-functional partnership - act as the systems partner to Sales, Finance, HR, R&D, and other leaders; translate business needs into scalable systems solutions.



WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Proven leadership experience in MIS / IT / business systems within SaaS or technology companies, including managing managers and multi-disciplinary teams.

  • Experience leading IT operations, information systems engineering, and business applications at scale in a distributed environment.

  • Demonstrated experience driving AI and automation adoption, with a track record of delivering measurable productivity or efficiency gains.

  • Strong understanding of core business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS, Finance) and their integration and data architecture.

  • Solid grounding in IT security, governance, and compliance (IAM, endpoint/MDM, SOC 2, GDPR).

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with experience partnering with executives and supporting remote / multi-site teams.

  • Strategic and hands-on: able to set direction and roadmaps while staying close enough to systems and delivery to make sound technical decisions.

  • Budget ownership experience and a track record of managing vendors, consultants, and outsourced partners.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience scaling MIS/IT in a high-growth, globally distributed SaaS company.

  • Hands-on familiarity with AI/LLM tooling, automation platforms, and internal copilot development.

  • Experience owning systems through compliance audits (SOC 2, ISO 27001).

  • Relevant degree or certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP, cloud or security certifications).

description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Product Operations Lead to play a key role in product launches, planning processes, AI adoption and operational efficiency. This role will ensure product availability, process optimization, and KPI tracking, working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success teams. The ideal candidate will drive seamless product delivery, scale best practices, and enhance the product management lifecycle.

lists.content:
Product Launch & Go-to-Market Readiness

  • Drive cross-functional product launch planning, ensuring clear responsibilities and execution timelines.
  • Develop together with Product Marketing scalable launch playbooks to standardize and optimize the GTM process.
  • Track and measure launch success through key metrics such as adoption, usage, and retention.
  • Ensure internal teams are enabled with product documentation, updates, release notes and other enablement principles
  • Partner with Customer Success to optimize post-launch support and user experience.
  • Monitor product readiness and ensure alignment between Product, R&D, Support and GTM teams.
    • AI & Builder Approach
  • Work AI-first - use Claude and the connected stack (JIRA, Confluence, Vitally, Gong, Slack) as the default method for drafting, analysis, and synthesis, not an occasional shortcut.
  • Build the tooling you need. Ship lightweight internal tools - scripts, agents, digests, dashboards - that remove recurring manual work in release and launch operations, without waiting for an engineering roadmap slot.
  • Contribute to Product Brain, our internal AI knowledge layer, and design operational workflows that pull context from connected systems rather than reassembling it by hand each cycle.
  • Own AI adoption within Product Operations - find the manual work a system should be doing, prototype the replacement, and prove it works before asking anyone to adopt it.
  • Apply judgment on where automation belongs. Know which decisions, escalations, and communications need a human, and keep those human.

    • KPI Tracking & Operational Excellence

  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure release and launch effectiveness.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance speed and efficiency.
  • Leverage data insights to drive continuous optimization of product operations workflows.
  • Own and optimize tooling and dashboards to provide real-time visibility into product health.
  • Partner with R&D to streamline deployment workflows, product maintenance and incident response guidelines.

    •

Required Skills & Experience

  • At least 7 years in Product Operations, Business Development or Product Lifecycle Management within a SaaS or technology-driven company.
  • Experience with feature or Product delivery, value driven decision making and coordinating product launches and releases.
  • Experience in  agile & kanban development, release processes, and change management.
  • Hands-on daily use of AI tools in real work, with concrete examples of what changed as a result.
  • Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, or similar release tracking tools.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in tracking and analyzing product performance metrics, overseeing execution strategy and tactical improvements
  • Comfortable contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product pipeline
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Desired Skills

  • Knowledge of SaaS business models, pricing strategies, and GTM execution.
  • Familiarity with customer adoption and retention analytics.
  • Experience working with API-first or developer-focused products.
  • Experience building internal tools or automations that other teams actually adopted.
  • Familiarity with LLM-based workflows — prompt and agent design, MCP connectors, or similar.

    •

• Efficient and predictable releases, with minimal delays or incidents.
  • Stronger cross-functional coordination, improving launch readiness.
  • Standardized product operations processes, improving efficiency and scalability.
  • Data-driven decision-making, leveraging insights to optimize release and launch performance.
  • Higher product adoption rates, increasing user engagement and retention.
  • Reduced manual operational load, with recurring coordination and reporting work replaced by AI-assisted workflows and internal tooling.

lists.content:
• Design and ship AI-powered copilots, agents, and decision-support tools for the product team, starting with pricing

  • Build data pipelines and analytical models for pricing intelligence

  • Develop autonomous agents that automate recurring product tasks

  • Automate manual workflows across product tools so the right action happens when a signal fires

  • Build LLM-based scoring models that give roadmap and prioritization decisions a data backbone

  • Collaborate with builders across Engineering, CS, GTM, and other teams to co-create solutions that scale

  • Ability to connect systems independently: APIs, webhooks, data pipelines

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across diverse teams

  • Ability to prioritize, problem-solve, and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment

  • Comfortable learning and applying new technologies, tools, and methodologies

About the Role
We're looking for a Senior AI Solutions Builder to join our Product - CTO Ops team. In this role, you will design, build, and ship AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity and drive measurable business value across the organization.
You will operate at the intersection of AI, data, pricing and business - owning the end-to-end development of agents, copilots, and workflow automations that directly inform decisions and eliminate manual work.
You are both a builder and an enabler. You ship solutions yourself and raise the AI capability floor for the teams around you. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, CS,  Sales, and builders across the company to deliver outcomes that improve decision velocity, product and operational efficiency, and long-term growth.
